sql:
SELECT
    CAST(
        SUM(e.cost) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff') AS REAL
    ) / SUM(e.cost) * 100
FROM
    expense e
JOIN
    budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN
    event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
